name: Nitro Horizon
storyline:
In a neon-lit future where underground racing has become the ultimate test of skill, speed, and precision, drivers from across the circuit compete for a place at the top of the championship.

Enter Nitro Horizon, a high-speed arcade racing competition where every corner, drift, and nitro boost can decide the outcome. Starting with a single car, you must earn credits, unlock faster and more capable vehicles, and overcome increasingly skilled AI rivals across six challenging circuits.

From fast city streets to atmospheric tracks shaped by changing weather, every race pushes your driving skills further. Master the racing line, control your drifts, time your nitro boosts, and climb through the championship until you face the toughest competition.

There is only one goal: become the ultimate champion and conquer the Nitro Horizon.
summary: Nitro Horizon is a neon-inspired top-down arcade racing game from InfinitByte Studios. Race against AI rivals across six unique circuits, master high-speed drifting and nitro boosts, unlock seven distinct vehicles, and compete across Arcade Race, Time Attack, and Championship modes. Earn credits, improve your garage, and climb the leaderboard in a fast-paced single-player racing experience.
